releases.name: The Crust
releases.summary:
The Crust is a game in which you are given the role of CEO of a giant lunar colonization company. It is a large-scale economic simulation game in which you have to find a balance between survival and development, managing the infrastructure, resources and team.

Mine valuable resources, automate production, manage scientific expeditions, and explore the lunar surface. 

400,000 kilometers away from Earth, you will see just how vast the cosmos really is, and how little we yet know about its mysteries. Get ready to face some tough choices- after all, the future of mankind may depend on your decisions...

releases.name: Black Gold: Oil Drilling Simulator
releases.summary:
Black Gold is a first person management simulator game where you take your place in the race for money.

You are the one responsible for your success: decide who work for you, choose where you put your first steps and control how well your oil wells run.

After you sell your first crude oil barrel, your wallet will grow quickly. Spend money to discover new technology, enlarge your workplace, buy new machines or upgrade them.

releases.name: I Need to Fix My Dream Car (But I Work at a Junkyard)
Tides of Caldmere
releases.summary: 2000 years ago, a world filled with wizards was once cloaked in darkness by an ultimate evil.The Frost Queen froze the entire world with her dark magic. None of the wizards were her match or able to defeat her.At the dawn of this devastation, a supreme Grand Master Wizard rose from the darkness! He fought countless bouts and finally sealed the queen into a timeless zone. The world of wizard's original glow was restored. Although no one knew the where about of the hero, the world of wizards built several academies to train new generations of wizards to protect themselves against new evils.Rumor spread that every 2000 years, the seal will weaken and the frost queen may break through in an attempt to rise to power, and claim vengeance....ObjectiveYou are destined to be a savor! Play as the new principal of Wizard Academy to manage this giant pool of talented wizards and put an end to this ultimate evil! Game features:-Manage and simulate student progress through 3 years of intensive wizard trainingschool!-Student wizards have their own attributes and a dream career to be fulfilled!-80 Quests with invasion system that puts your wizard world at stake!-Buildup to 70 facilities with 5 beautiful levels of wizard academy castle!-Fight amongst 200+ other schools to be the top academy!

releases.name: Time Gamers: Guardians of the Marble Man
releases.summary: Guardians of the Marble Man is a historical adventure set in 1864 Columbia, South Carolina, recreated through years of research. As a Time Gamer, you search for the lost Roman statue of John C. Calhoun, uncovering secrets tied to secession, war, and hidden history beneath the Old State House.

releases.name: Flower Fairy Survivor
releases.summary: This is a traditional, light-hearted survival game where completing levels unlocks more skills, allowing you to easily challenge more difficult levels.

releases.name: Piano Warrior
releases.summary: Simple but subtle, Cross Flip is a puzzle game in which you will try to flip pieces and match the target pattern. Excise your reasoning ability in Cross Flip! Each piece has two sides: black side and white one. Tap on one piece will toggle the side of it and the surrounding pieces(up, bottom, left and right). Match side of all pieces with target pattern in the upper right screen perfectly to solve each puzzle. Take the level challenge from simple patterns to challenging ones!If the level challenge is not enough, try the random challenge! Cross Flip will generate each game randomly and make your challenge never stop.Features:1. Excise your reasoning and logic thinking ability;2. Easy to begin and simple to play;3. 90 levels, random challenge, 5x5, 6x6 and 7x7 board.Hope you enjoy this game!

releases.name: Shady job
releases.summary: A co-op adventure game. The mafia wants to get rid of a body. You’re construction workers. Your job: carry a body bag to the top of a skyscraper. Bury it in concrete. Two problems. First: You have to build the way up. Second: The body’s not dead. It fights back.

releases.name: Total Futsal Manager
releases.summary: Take control of a futsal club and build your career season after season. Manage your squad, transfers, contracts, training, tactics, finances, and dressing room as you compete to take your team all the way to the top.

releases.name: Pool Shark
releases.summary: Real 8-ball physics with fake money on every rack. A roguelike deckbuilder built on pool: draft from 204 cards, call your shots, run eighteen money matches in one night, and settle a $12,500 debt before close. Then take it online — ranked 1v1 on a live ladder. Chalk up.

releases.name: Journey to Echo
releases.summary: Explore a handcrafted post-apocalyptic world, drive your vehicle across abandoned roads, scavenge for vital resources, repair communication systems, and survive against infected while searching for the last remaining outposts.

releases.name: Asteroid Destroyer (ermu_cz)
releases.summary: Tank Invasion is a tactical action war game in the spirit of Cannon Fodder and Commandos, but adapted to smart phones. The game offers an innovative semi-turn based mechanic that offers fast paced action without the need for quick reflexes  and clicking at every enemy. Instead combat progresses in turns and will pause for issuing commands.In the game you command teams of Tanks, Bazookas and Infantry to search and destroy an enemy base. In the Conquest game mode you have find and capture enemy outposts to build your army before you can attack the base. In the Skirmish game mode you start with an army and need recon the enemy base to decide best attack direction and strategy. Destroying enemies will also give you experience to pick Perks that help you in the mission.The best strategy is to utilize unit advantages:- Tanks will win Infantry- Infantry will win Bazookas- Bazookas will win TanksI.e. you should try to take out isolated enemies with units of advantage and try to avoid battles where you will be at disadvantage. FEATURES:- Multiple units to use: Tanks, Infantry and Bazookas- Two distinct game modes: Conquest and Skirmish- Turn-based gameplay that pauses the game for issuing orders and does not require hectic button mashing - RPG elements with perks earned from experience - Gameplay customizable to liking with settings for difficulty, game speed, number of soldiers, map size and how often game pauses during combatTactical Invasion is a sister game to Infantry Invasion and Tactical Invasion that take different perspective on the same theme.The game is free, but but to customize the gameplay to your liking you need to unlock the custom game mode. This allows you to set the difficulty, game speed, map size, unit size and how often combat is paused for issuing orders.

releases.name: Stall Quest
releases.summary: A shopkeeping simulation RPG for those who loved leaving shops open in old-school MMOs! Open a stall in Rei's dream, sell items gathered from dungeons, buy gear, and dive back in. Packed with 48 enemies, 30 items, and excitement! Try it out!
